description: This file contains unit tests for authentication hashing utilities, including password hashing, verification, migration, and tenant salt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Imports function to get security pepper used in hashing processes.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes passwords using legacy v1 method, reliant on SECRET_SALT.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes passwords with newer v2 method, incorporating tenant orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a provided password against stored hash and version, considering tenant orgSalt and pepper.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures each tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving it if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Wrapper function that defaults to v2 password hashing, respecting tenant orgSalt and pepper.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a password for a user, automatically migrating legacy v1 hashes to v2 if needed.
